title: Set system locale
summary: Change the system-wide language and region settings, such as date formats and currency symbols.

steps.explain: Set a specific locale variable (like LANG) to a new value. You usually need root privileges for this.

placeholders.name: LOCALE_VAR
placeholders.description: The locale variable to set, e.g., LANG, LC_ALL, LC_TIME.

placeholders.name: LOCALE_VALUE
placeholders.description: The desired locale setting, e.g., en_US.UTF-8, ru_RU.UTF-8.

rollback.explain: To revert, set the locale variable back to its previous value using the same command.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_VALUE
placeholders.description: The locale value it had before you changed it.

warnings: Changing the system locale can affect how dates, numbers, and currencies are displayed in applications.
You may need to log out and back in for changes to take full effect.
